How it will look in Discord.
디스코드 한 메시지 제한(일반 2000자 · Nitro 4000자) 안에: Automatically fitted to Discord's per-message limit (2000 characters, or 4000 with Nitro).
Press 'Copy for Discord', then paste it into a Discord chat and send.
On a phone, the same options are under the 'Settings' button at the bottom.
Draws each cell with 8 dots, for the finest shapes.
Splits each cell into a top and bottom color, for the most accurate color.
Draws outlines and shading with the shapes of characters.
Picks characters that follow line directions; good for line art and logos.

디스코드 기본 색만 써서 글자 수가 적게 듭니다. '글자+배경'은 배경색: Uses only Discord's basic colors, so it needs fewer characters. 'Text + background' colors the background too; 'Text color only' colors just the text.
Draws with characters only, no color codes.
무엇을 골라야 할지 모르겠다면 '✦ 추천 조합 찾기'를 누르세요. 글자: Not sure what to pick? Press '✦ Find best settings'. For each style it searches for the width, number of colors and adjustments that look closest to the original within the character limit, and shows them as cards.
Click a card to apply its settings.
While searching, the button turns into '■ Stop' so you can cancel any time.
Under 'Also adjust' you can choose which adjustments the search may change.
Click to turn it on or off; press and hold to show it only while held.
원본에서 찾은 윤곽의 방향입니다. 파랑은 뚜렷한 윤곽, 빨강은 모서리와: Shows the edge directions found in the original. Blue is a clear edge, red is a corner or fine texture.
켜면 끌어서 옮기고 휠이나 두 손가락으로 확대합니다. 결과 · 원본 ·: When on, drag to pan and use the wheel or two fingers to zoom. The result, original and edge map move together, so you can compare the same spot.
Returns to the original size. Double-clicking does the same.
With Move off, you can select the result text with the mouse.
묶음 제목을 눌러 펼칩니다. 값을 바꾼 묶음에는 점이 표시되고, ↺ 로: Click a group title to open it. Groups with changed values show a dot, and ↺ resets just that group.
대비 · 밝기 · 선명도 · 배경 지우기. '자동 보정'으로 한 번에 맞: Contrast, brightness, sharpness and background removal. 'Auto adjust' sets them in one go.
More columns give more detail but use more characters.
Press 'Paint area' in the Color group to paint over the original with a brush. Only the painted areas get more or less saturation.
오른쪽 버튼이나 Alt 를 누른 채 칠하면 지웁니다. 다 칠했으면 Esc: Paint with the right button or while holding Alt to erase. Press Esc when you are done.
Available in 16 colors and Truecolor only.

Copies only the characters, without color codes.

PC에서 세부 조정 > 고급 > 기기 측정값 > '측정값 파일로 저장'을: On your PC, go to Fine-tuning > Advanced > Device measurements > 'Save measurements file', move the file to your phone, then choose it with 'Open measurements file'.

모드·글자 수 제한·그림 비율에 맞춰 색과 크기의 균형이 좋은 열 수를: Picks the column count that best balances color and size for the mode, character limit and picture shape. Moving the slider uses your own value.
가로 칸 수는 처음에 '자동'입니다. 글자 수 제한 안에서 색과 형태가: Columns start on 'Auto': it picks the column count that keeps color and shape best within the character limit, for the mode and picture shape. Moving the slider uses your own value; press 'Auto' to go back.
칠한 곳의 색이 원본과 다르면 손해를 이만큼 더 크게 봅니다 — 글자 수: Counts color mismatches in painted areas this much more — spends more characters to get those colors right
Press 'Paint area' in the Color group to paint over the original with a brush. Painted areas get their saturation changed and their colors matched more closely.
'칠한 곳 색 우선'을 올리면 글자 수를 더 써서라도 칠한 곳의 색을 정: Raise 'Painted area color priority' to spend more characters on getting painted colors right. To keep saturation unchanged and only prioritize color, set 'Saturation in painted area' to 0%.

첫 장면으로 설정을 고른 뒤 만드세요. 모든 장면이 같은 설정 · 같은: Pick settings on the first frame, then make it. Every frame uses the same settings and column count.

The preview is drawn like a Discord code block, with no gaps between lines.
움직이는 GIF나 영상(mp4 · webm · mov 등)을 넣으면 자동: Animated GIFs and videos (mp4, webm, mov, …) are detected automatically. The first frame appears in the preview, and a 'Make GIF' button ('Make MP4' for videos) appears below the result.
Choose the style, colors or a suggestion while looking at the first frame, as usual.
'GIF 만들기' 또는 'MP4 만들기'를 누르면 모든 장면을 같은 설정: Press 'Make GIF' or 'Make MP4' to convert every frame with the same settings and column count. Press it again while running to stop.
끝나면 GIF는 GIF로, 영상은 MP4로 바로 저장되고, 결과 창에서: When it finishes, a GIF is saved as a GIF and a video as an MP4, and the result window plays it.
장면 하나하나가 사진과 같은 엔진 · 같은 품질로 변환되고, 디스코드에: Each frame goes through the same engine at the same quality as a photo, and is drawn the way it would look pasted into Discord.
For videos, choose 'Frames per second' (default 12) in the Image section. More is smoother but slower.
Both GIFs and videos are converted up to the first 20 seconds. Sound is not included.
장면이 많은 GIF는 파일이 커집니다(디스코드 무료 업로드 한도 10MB: GIFs with many frames get large (Discord's free upload limit is 10 MB). For longer clips, a video turned into an MP4 is much smaller.
영상 만들기는 최신 Chrome · Edge · Safari가 필요합니다: Making videos needs a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari. If the video can't be read, convert it to a format the browser supports (mp4, webm).
